info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Carrental Reservations Insurances-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Information Retrieval API provides access to details about insurances associated with car rental reservations. This endpoint allows users to list the insurance options linked to their reservations, facilitating informed decision-making. Typical consumers include car rental agencies, backend systems, and customer service representatives who need to verify or present insurance details to customers. This API enables the efficient management of insurance data, ensuring clarity and transparency in rental agreements.
